decisions.reason: Report grounds the diagnosis in symptom-log and contrast-probe evidence: the tab opens with a correct title (claim/registration layer works) while meta.status stays 'none', attributing the empty tab to the api-workspace-files Remote → host workspaceFiles provider delivery chain never answering, explicitly not to render code, disk, or the workspace; role-level naming used, equivalent to exact symbols.

Uses the contrast reader decisively: file-trace reads the same file at the same moment via its own RPC while the sidebar tab's workspaceFiles read stalls, explicitly ruling out the file, disk, permissions, host death, and claim layer, and localizing the failure to the workspace-files resource-provider/RPC delivery on the upgraded profile, cross-referenced to #5999.

Credits the per-module sweep (62/62 HTTP 200) and single-module combo probe as the valid static-serving measurement, and explicitly rejects the all-62-joined URL 404 as non-evidence because the real loader never issues such a URL (fetches each roster entry's own URL) and a 4–5 KB URL can 404 for length/routing limits — matching the 3 KB combo-URL-cap reasoning without the constant name.

Keeps both distractors separate: dsh-paste-input fold-skip warnings are called an unrelated paste-marker parsing bug of another plugin, and the textpreview→documentpreview rename is said to explain only the absolute-scope claim dialog, not the empty session-scoped tab whose content read stalls in the Remote chain.

Orders actions correctly: cheap host restart first (citing the #5999 alpha.1 self-heal precedent), pinned rollback to a verified previous version (0.1.5-alpha.1 or the #5999-verified 0.1.3-alpha.2) as escape hatch, forensics packaged upstream to discussion #5999 with the sweep, contrast probe, roster excerpt and joined-URL caveat, explicit refusal of plugin-side rewrites/retries/fallbacks, and concrete boot-time fail-loud gates (serving consistency, Remote/provider completeness, stall-to-error conversion).
